videos.title: Kansas Senate Race Turns Into Tossup, Sabato Says
videos.description: The US Senate race in Kansas has turned into a tossup according to pollster Larry Sabato. Polls show incumbent Republican Roger Marshall and Democratic challenger Adam Hamilton are neck-and-neck. A Democrat hasn't won this seat in almost 100 years. videos.title: Treasuries Soar as Tech Slump Threatens Growth
videos.description: Treasuries led a global bond rally as a selloff in artificial-intelligence shares deepened, spurring demand for havens from a growth slowdown. A measure of CoreWeave’s credit risk climbed to an all-time high Thursday as its high-yield bonds extended declines. We get reaction from Bloomberg Tech host Ed Ludlow. Steve Kaplan of JPMorgan Asset Management joins to discuss trends in portfolio diversification. Bloomberg's Austin Carr examines Marc Andreessen's rise as a MAGA power player ahead of midterms. Plus - US producer prices rose in September at the fastest pace in more than four years as higher energy costs reverberated through the US economy. We examine what it could mean for monetary policy with Frank Monkam, Bloomberg News Macro Strategist. All on the latest episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
